metadata.target_role: Project Executive - PMO Center of Excellence

red_flags.detail: PMP is required by the JD; resume lists it only as 'initiated; committed to acquiring immediately'.
BS Psychology/Sociology and MSW are not in the JD's listed fields (Business, PM, Engineering, IS or related).
ringldr (June 2018-Present) overlaps GEHA, Cornerstones and Vanyshr; unexplained. Roles ordered by start date; GEHA and ringldr both start June 2018.
22% on-time and 18% overrun metrics repeated in Summary and ringldr bullet; Summary places them beside Netsmart, implying a different source. No baseline or portfolio size.
Skills mirror JD wording (EVM, schedule audits, P6, PSA, training) with no supporting bullets.
Headline title is the target job title, not a title held.
Mixed '2024' vs 'Month YYYY' date formats; 'Professional Experience' instead of 'Work Experience'.
'Returning candidate with deep platform and delivery knowledge' is an application note, not resume content.

parsing_risks: [DATE RISK] Inconsistent date formats (year-only for Vanyshr vs Month YYYY elsewhere)
[CHRONOLOGY RISK] Roles ordered by start date; overlapping tenures starting June 2018
[HEADING RISK] 'Professional Experience' instead of canonical 'Work Experience' (low)

must_haves: Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (degree is Psychology/Sociology)
10+ years managing detailed master project schedules (only ~4-6 demonstrated)
Evidence of conducting PMO audits / Center of Excellence leadership (claimed, not demonstrated)
Earned value management, percent-complete tracking (keyword only, no evidence)
preferred: Evaluating and implementing project management technologies and reporting solutions
Implementing or optimizing PSA and resource management processes (keyword only)
Advanced executive dashboard / performance reporting experience (keyword only)

priority_actions.description: Obtain PMP or list a scheduled exam date; remove 'committed to acquiring immediately' wording.
Add dated, quantified bullets proving EVM, percent-complete, schedule risk analysis, schedule audits, and tool use (MS Project, P6, Smartsheet, PSA).
Attribute 22%/18% results to the correct employer or client with portfolio size, baseline and timeframe; remove ambiguity in the Summary.
Rewrite the Netsmart bullets with outcomes (on-time %, budget, go-live slip) instead of volume-only claims.
Clarify concurrent roles, standardize dates to Month YYYY, fix reverse-chronological ordering, drop the 'Returning candidate' line, use a real held title in the headline.
Compress Vanyshr to two bullets emphasizing AI workflow automation with measurable results; bridge the degree gap.
